'''Myoris Lin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] teacher who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Harix]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The mother of a young boy named [[Berd Lin|Berd]], Lin taught at a school with ties to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which drew the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Stafuv Rahz]] and a complement of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] kidnapped Lin and most of her class, hoping to use them to draw out key Rebel leaders. Only Lin's son Berd escaped, and he managed to recruit Rebels [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to lead a rescue mission. Although Rahz planned to execute Lin and the captives personally within their school, Skywalker and Solo arrived just in time to rescue them. Afterward, Lin, her son, and her students fled Harix with the Rebels.<ref name="BMTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Myoris Lin first appeared in ''[[Bring Me the Children]]'', a [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc written by [[Don Christensen]] and released in [[1980]]. In his comic appearance, Lin was illustrated by [[Russ Manning]].<ref name="BMTC" /> Although originally identified only as Myoris in ''Bring Me the Children'', her last name of Lin was given 27 years later, in [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] supplement ''[[Aliens in the Empire]]''.<ref name="aite">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/97/indexp4.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils}} {{1stID|Lin}}</ref>
